snippet.title: Together Again: A Lake's Funland Story / OFFICIAL TRAILER
snippet.description:
Ashley Waters, a 17 year old student from Montreal has one duty, to uncover the truth behind the mysterious disappearance of 3 children from a nearby town for a final school thesis. When the day her mother asks her to take a job as the night watch at local restaurant for family and children arrives, Ashley finds herself forced to spend the nights chased down by unfriendly robot machines, until a breath taking truth is revealed to her.

After 5 months since the release of the cinematic teaser trailer, here's the first official trailer for "Together Again: A Lake's Funland Story" with both cinematic and gameplay footage.

~CREDITS~
Rendering and Editing - Heisenmorg
50's video overlay and title distortion - MaximumElevapor
Gameplay - Sunken Studios
-Lighth0use as Ashley Waters
Stephanie Pilavin as Rachel Waters
Hudson Harris as *******
Music:
- "Nocturne op. 9 No. 2" by Chopin
- "Alien Invasion" by Rafael Krux

Follow the game's page: https://gamejolt.com/games/together_again_at_lakes/555001
https://heisenmorg.itch.io/together-again-a-lakes-funland-story
And if you haven't already, check out my website: https://heisenmorg.netlify.app/
